description: This file defines a template interface IIteratorType within the Thunder::RPC namespace, representing a generic iterator with methods for traversal and access, intended for use with different element types and interface IDs.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for a generic iterator with methods for traversal, validation, and element access.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, outputting it via the reference parameter.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, outputting it via the reference parameter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current position of the iterator is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements available through the iterator.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.
